---
name: Java CI Workflow
description: This GitHub Actions workflow sets up a Java environment, compiles the code, builds the project, and runs unit tests. It ensures that the correct Java version is used throughout the process
---
create a github action ci.yml that runs on ubuntu latest, java and tumerin. the ci.yml should include steps to set up the Java environment, compile the code, build the project, and run unit tests. It should also ensure that the correct Java version is used throughout the process. the triggers are main and develop branches. exclude any other branches from triggering the workflow.
